scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan engagement party in a traditional salon with long sedari sofas and pastries; BRIDEMOM talking animatedly, waving her bejewelled hands, scheming expression, seen over DAD's shoulder who watches her suspiciously; head-to-waist framing, faces visible, comic tension

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: close-up of DAD sitting on a Moroccan salon sofa at an engagement party, eyes narrowed with suspicion, stroking his beard, tea glass in hand

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: BRIDEDAD sitting silent and small on the sofa, staring at the floor, fingering prayer beads, while BRIDEMOM beside him keeps talking loudly with big gestures, Moroccan salon

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: night, a Moroccan family walking back into their modest Salé house through the front door after the engagement, DAD in front looking serious, SON smiling, MOM and GIRL behind

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night, DAD seriously warning SON, pointing his finger, SON listening with crossed arms and annoyed face

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SON standing up angrily refusing, hand raised, shouting, DAD seated looking hurt, Moroccan living room

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SON signing a marriage contract at a table with an adoul notary in white djellaba, proud defiant look, Moroccan office

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MOM crying on a Moroccan salon sofa wiping tears with her headscarf, GIRL sitting next to her comforting her with a hand on her shoulder, sad

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: DAD sitting on the edge of a bed holding his chest in pain, worried face, dim Moroccan bedroom, medicine box on the side table
